scope: Controlled subprocess boundary tests only. No real Docker or broker qualification.

race.sourceBinding: Frozen source bytes verified after the recorded race run and unchanged before/after vet. Existing historical failures were draft fixture-dispatch defects.

environment.platform: native Linux process inside Ubuntu-26.04 WSL

patternCheck.finding: Review is stale or missing: inspect changes and refresh sourceDigest

limits: The internal LockHeld assertion is not an OS lock proof.
Full boot config and secret file handling remains required; this slice refuses it.
Authenticated readiness, real cold/warm lifecycle, concurrency, killed-owner recovery, rollback and persistence are not qualified by this record.
Command timeout leaves the engine-side outcome unknown; no automatic retry is performed.
WarmReuse is read-only; callers must select it for healthy existing resources.
